heard: A dead star 20,000 light-years away just screamed at us. This magnetar has a magnetic field trillions of times stronger than Earth. The star's crust shattered in a massive explosion during August 1998. The blast was so violent, it overwhelmed satellite detectors across our solar system. This eruption created a pulsating tail spinning every 5.16 seconds. Years later, Spitzer captured a mysterious 7-light-year ring of fire. The entire galaxy heard that dead star scream from 20,000 light-years away.
